name: AWS VPC Flow Logs
description: Amazon’s Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) Flow Logs log the IP network traffic of your VPC, allowing you to troubleshoot traffic and security issues. The Sumo Logic App for Amazon VPC Flow Logs leverages this data to provide real-time visibility and analysis of your environment. It consists of predefined searches, and Live and Interactive Dashboards.
